records.query: How many days do customers have to request a return under the standard returns policy?
records.response_text:
### Standard return window
Customers on the standard plan may request a return within **30 calendar days of delivery**.

TrailPlus members receive a different return window. See the TrailPlus Membership Policy. The membership must have been active when the order was placed. [01-returns-policy-current.md > Standard return window]

### Return shipping and refunds
A **$6.95 return shipping fee** is deducted from the refund for standard domestic returns. The fee is waived when Aster & Row sent the wrong item or the item arrived damaged.

Refunds are issued to the original payment method after the return is inspected. Customers should allow **5–7 business days after inspection** for the refund to appear.

Original outbound shipping charges are not refundable unless the order was incorrect or damaged on arrival. [01-returns-policy-current.md > Return shipping and refunds]

### Reports after seven days
A manufacturing defect reported after the seven-day arrival window may be considered under the Warranty Policy. Normal wear, accidental damage, and misuse are not arrival defects.

The support agent must not promise that a refund or replacement has been approved before a human review is completed. [04-damaged-or-wrong-items.md > Reports after seven days]

claim_details.claim_text: Customers on the standard plan may request a return within 30 calendar days of delivery

records.query: How long does order processing take before an order is dispatched?
records.response_text:
### Processing time
Most orders require **1–2 business days** for processing before they are dispatched. Business days exclude weekends and United States federal holidays. [05-domestic-shipping.md > Processing time]

### Address changes
An address correction may be requested within 30 minutes while an order is still pending. A human support specialist must complete the change.

After an order enters processing, Aster & Row cannot guarantee an address change. After shipment, the customer may contact the carrier, but carrier changes are outside Aster & Row’s control. [08-order-changes-and-cancellations.md > Address changes]

### Canada delivery estimate
Canadian orders generally arrive within **5–9 business days after dispatch**. Processing time before dispatch is usually 1–2 business days.

Delivery estimates may be extended by customs processing or carrier delays. [06-international-shipping.md > Canada delivery estimate]

### Cancellation window
A customer may request cancellation within **30 minutes of placing an order**, but only while the order status is `pending`.

A cancellation cannot be guaranteed. Once the status changes to `processing`, `shipped`, `delivered`, or another later state, the order cannot be cancelled through the normal cancellation process. [08-order-changes-and-cancellations.md > Cancellation window]

claim_details.claim_text: Most orders require 1–2 business days for processing before they are dispatched

records.query: If I discover a manufacturing defect after 7 days, can I still get help?
records.response_text:
### Reports after seven days
A manufacturing defect reported after the seven-day arrival window may be considered under the Warranty Policy. Normal wear, accidental damage, and misuse are not arrival defects.

The support agent must not promise that a refund or replacement has been approved before a human review is completed. [04-damaged-or-wrong-items.md > Reports after seven days]

### Final-sale products
A product being marked final sale does not remove the limited warranty for a qualifying manufacturing defect. [07-warranty.md > Final-sale products]

### What is covered
The limited warranty covers manufacturing defects in materials or workmanship under normal use. Examples may include a seam that separates without misuse or a zipper mechanism that fails because of a manufacturing defect. [07-warranty.md > What is covered]

### Reporting window
Customers should report an item that arrived damaged, visibly defective, or different from what was ordered within **7 calendar days of delivery**.

The customer should provide the order ID, a short description, and clear photographs of the item and packaging when reasonably possible. [04-damaged-or-wrong-items.md > Reporting window]

### Warranty and care
Damage caused by cleaning methods that conflict with this guide is not covered by the limited warranty. [11-product-care.md > Warranty and care]

records.query: Can I send my complete gift card code in the chat for you to check the balance?
records.response_text:
### Gift cards
Aster & Row gift cards do not expire. Gift cards are final sale and cannot be returned, exchanged for cash, or used to purchase another gift card, except where required by law.

The agent must not ask a customer to share a complete gift-card code in chat. [10-gift-cards-and-price-adjustments.md > Gift cards]

### What counts as final sale
An item is final sale only when the product page, cart, or order confirmation clearly labels it **FINAL SALE**. A discount or promotional code does not automatically make an item final sale.

Gift cards are always final sale. [03-final-sale-and-promotions.md > What counts as final sale]

### Exclusions and exceptions
Final-sale items and gift cards are not returnable for a change of mind. Damaged or incorrect final-sale items may still qualify for assistance under the Damaged or Wrong Items Policy.

Warranty claims are handled separately from ordinary returns. [01-returns-policy-current.md > Exclusions and exceptions]

### Cleaning
The product card states that **all components are dishwasher safe**, with the top rack recommended.

Do not place the tumbler or lid in a microwave. Avoid abrasive scrubbers that may damage the finish. [12-breeze-tumbler-product-card.md > Cleaning]
